title: GLHS R4 Phase 0 / E17: Current-State Insufficiency Witness Protocol
phase: Phase 0 — Prospective Experimental & Statistical Plan for R4

primary_endpoints.name: C0 False Admission Rate on Substituted Proposals
primary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of disclosure-substituted proposals admitted by CURRENT_STATE_ONLY (C0).

primary_endpoints.name: C4 False Admission Rate on Substituted Proposals
primary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of disclosure-substituted proposals admitted by FULL_GRWC (C4).

secondary_endpoints.name: C1 False Admission Rate on Substituted Proposals
secondary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of disclosure-substituted proposals admitted by OCC_READSET (C1).

secondary_endpoints.name: C3 False Admission Rate on Substituted Proposals
secondary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of disclosure-substituted proposals admitted by SIGNED_EXACT_DISCLOSURE_TOKEN (C3).

secondary_endpoints.name: Clean Proposal Admission Rate across All Arms
secondary_endpoints.definition: Proportion of P_good proposals admitted by C0, C1, C3, and C4.

sample_size.unit_definition: 100 deterministic paired clinical witness scenarios (P_good, P_substituted) spanning antimicrobial stewardship, anticoagulation, pediatric weight, and renal clearance

statistical_plan.method: Exact Binomial Counterexample Witness Evaluation and Paired McNemar Concordance Test

stopping_rules.fail_closed_criteria: Halt immediately if C4 fails to reject any P_substituted witness scenario (Gate 3 failure).
stopping_rules.missing_data_rule: Incomplete scenario executions fail closed and block insufficiency witness certification.
